digest.component_or_area: Pandoc corpus verification and Gerrit Verify gate
propositions: Gerrit Verify performs complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every change, contributing a measured 184.32-second macOS baseline that should be moved to external scheduled jobs while retaining contractual assertions

The implementation provides deterministic committed Pandoc outputs covering 1,383 conversions across 178 bodies in three artifact files to enable static verification in per-change Verify without subprocess replay

Three representative live product-path bodies (one each from code_arrow, table, and prose strata) remain in Gerrit Verify to retain real Pandoc behavior coverage while removing bulk corpus subprocess work
A new external pandoc-corpus-replay job in the weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch runs complete real-Pandoc replay across all corpus units and settling passes on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest
Fixture regeneration and validation are deterministic and explicit, with a non-writing check command that validates committed bytes without modifying files

All existing corpus assertion classes, supported Python cells, supported operating systems, and Pandoc version/platform/argv probes remain in Gerrit Verify with no weakened assertions or removed behavioral coverage
